main_text.l: ciscano, ut dixi ante, situ in urbe me-
dio. Porrò Ecclesiæ ministri diebus do-
minicis ter docent in templo utroque, at-
que insuper, reliqua hebdomade bis in
templis jam dictis, nec quenquam ad
ante de mysterio benè edoctum, & ca-
piumque: cæteros ab ea arcent. Reliqua
quoque ministerii sui ritè expediunt. In
primis quolibet mense semel cœtum vel
conventum agunt in urbe cum ministris

page.notes: The first word of the page continues a sentence from the previous page. The catchword "Lavi-" is printed at the foot with its hyphen. Initial V of "Vrbe" in the running head is read as U (vowel). The long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
